title: Failed Rug
description: Rug pullers glow red for half a second before they dash; sidestep the dash and the rug puller trips, stunned for 1.5 s and taking double damage.

title: The Halving
description: At 4:00 and 8:00 the chart halves: a gold flash takes half the HP off every bear on screen, and your weapons fire twice as fast for 8 s.

title: Golden Bear
description: Once a run a gold bear sprints across the edge of the screen; catch it within 15 s and it bursts into a rain of gold candles and a free airdrop crate.
